court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 1999 and had a child. The wife left the matrimonial home in 2003 and refused to return. The husband filed for divorce on grounds of cruelty and desertion, which was dismissed by the trial court. This appeal is against that decision.

legal_principles.principle: If any spouse left the matrimonial home without any valid reason and there was no reunion for the period of two years, they are entitled to seek for divorce on the ground of desertion.
legal_principles.held: Though, in this case, the husband filed a divorce on the ground that the wife left the matrimonial home without any valid reason and she is living separately for more than two years and therefore, he is entitled for divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other spouse has deserted him/her without any valid reason.
legal_principles.held: Though, in this case, the husband filed a divorce on the ground that the wife left the matrimonial home without any valid reason and she is living separately for more than two years and therefore, he is entitled for divorce.

outcome.final_order: The final order set aside the judgment and decree made by the Family Court, Tirunelveli in H.M.O.P.No.88 of 2019, dated 22.01.2021.
